description: Source code implementing string map and set data structures with functions for initialization, insertion, removal, and lookup, utilizing hashmaps and memory pools.

methods.name: cmp_strmap_entry
methods.description: Comparison function for strmap entries used in hashmap, compares entries based on their keys.

methods.name: find_strmap_entry
methods.description: Finds a strmap entry by string key within a strmap.

methods.name: strmap_init
methods.description: Initializes a strmap to default state.

methods.name: strmap_init_with_options
methods.description: Initializes a strmap with custom memory pool and string duplication option.

methods.name: strmap_free_entries_
methods.description: Frees entries in a strmap, optionally freeing values.

methods.name: strmap_clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from a strmap, freeing resources.

methods.name: strmap_partial_clear
methods.description: Partially clears entries from a strmap, preserving some resources.

methods.name: create_entry
methods.description: Creates a new strmap entry with optional string duplication and memory pooling.

methods.name: strmap_put
methods.description: Inserts or updates an entry in the strmap.

methods.name: strmap_get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to a strmap entry by key.

methods.name: strmap_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key in the strmap.

methods.name: strmap_contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the strmap.

methods.name: strmap_remove
methods.description: Removes an entry from the strmap, optionally freeing its value.

methods.name: strintmap_incr
methods.description: Increments the integer value associated with a string key in strintmap.

methods.name: strset_add
methods.description: Adds a string to a strset, returns 1 if added, 0 if already present.
